items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: How satisfying was it to get that 5th? "Yeah I mean...it's for fifth place so there's a cap…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问：拿到第5名有多满足？"是的，我是说……这是第五名，所以兴奋程度有限，但确实在最后让比赛更刺激了，这很有趣。感觉这是一场合理的比赛。显然爆胎有点可惜，但我不认为它改变了太多，所以对此很满意。"
items.summary: Q: How satisfying was it to get that 5th? "Yeah I mean...it's for fifth place so there's a cap on the excitement but no certainly made it more exciting at the end which was good fun. Felt like it was a reasonable race. Obviously the puncture was a bit of a shame but I don't think it changed things too much so happy with that."
items.summary_zh: 问：拿到第5名有多满足？"是的，我是说……这是第五名，所以兴奋程度有限，但确实在最后让比赛更刺激了，这很有趣。感觉这是一场合理的比赛。显然爆胎有点可惜，但我不认为它改变了太多，所以对此很满意。"
